llm.summary: This is a disclosed Polymarket trading skill, but it needs Review because its live-money trading instructions still contain inconsistent claims about whether the strategy signal and magnitude filter are validated.

dimensions.detail: The core capability is purpose-aligned automated BTC 5-minute Polymarket trading with budget caps, but it can place real USDC trades, redeem winnings, and cancel attributed GTC orders when run live, so misleading efficacy or signal wording has high user impact.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Paper mode is default and live trading requires --live, but SKILL.md says the signal is the window-open candle while other text and the code use the prior complete candle, and one usage bullet still calls the magnitude filter validated despite repeated retraction language.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation requires simmer-sdk and SIMMER_API_KEY, with optional WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY for external-wallet use; clawhub.json sets autostart false and no cron by default.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to Simmer, Polymarket CLOB/Gamma, and Binance is expected for the stated trading purpose; local files are used for config, daily spend, and auto-redeem cooldown tracking.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to configuration, daily_spend.json, and .last_auto_redeem; financial actions are scoped by live mode, per-market caps, daily budget, dedup checks, and source/slug matching for order cancellation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review carefully before installing. The artifact does not show malware, hidden exfiltration, or surprise autostart, but it does automate real-money trading and its documentation is internally inconsistent about the strategy’s validation. Treat it as an unvalidated trading template, use paper mode first, keep budgets small, and do not rely on the claimed filter as a proven edge.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported in context: the strategy text still describes a window-open candle even though the artifact elsewhere says that candle caused look-ahead bias, and the code uses the last complete candle instead.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Supported in context: the usage guidance still says validated magnitude filter, while the retraction, disclaimer, and tunable labels say there is no validated edge; this inconsistency matters because the skill can trade real funds.
